properties.name: Cues reach the agent and are counted (increment 2 of cognition plus memory)
properties.rationale:
Increment 2 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory, for req:each-cue-is-counted-by-whether-the-agent-acted-on-it and req:reflow2-places-cues-on-the-agents-side-so-they-reach-an-agent-before-its-first-call (options (c) and (d) of dec:idea-cues-are-a-message-on-the-interface-between-reflow2-and-the-agent). The baseline: 245 cues, 4% followed within five calls, the commonest (set_decision_status, 101) addressed to an owner who was not there (fact:in-the-recall-pilot-agents-followed-4-percent-of-reflow2s-cues-within-five-calls-2026-10-29); and a budget-limited reader who scored 5.5/25 until one line said where the current state was kept (fact:root-cause-a-budget-limited-reader-was-not-cued-to-the-designs-current-state-record-2026-10-29). Ids are derived at the one choke point every reply passes rather than assigned at ~40 emit sites, so a new hint cannot forget one; they ride _meta, which a model is not shown, so naming cues adds no cue fatigue. Not built, recorded instead: a served compact read of a design's current VALUES (fact:reflow2-serves-no-compact-read-of-a-designs-current-values-2026-10-29); counting the hook's own copy of the first-read cue (the hook knows no seat). Increment 3 (the recall pilot re-run) reads these counts.
Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Every cue a reply offers that names a next call (loop_hint, hint, next, nudge, next_step naming a served tool or skill) now carries a derived id `<field>/<named call>`, in the reply's `_meta["reflow2/cues"]` and on its usage-ledger line; the handshake writes a `cue` line offering the first-read cue to the session; usage_report's tally gains a `cues` block counting, per cue, offered / followed within 5 / followed at all / unattributable and which tools offered it. The connect-time instructions and the kit's SessionStart texts (Claude Code, VS Code terminal route) name graph_report_markdown as the first read and search_design for the design's own current-state record. add_decision's and replace_text's settling hint goes to a call made for the owner; anyone else is told it is a question for the owner (ask_question). A nameless search hit carries `excerpt`. All additive: no tool, argument or field removed or renamed.
